facts.text: The resort is set directly on Waikiki Beach.
facts.excerpt: Set directly on one of the world's most iconic beaches, OUTRIGGER Waikiki Beach Resort brings a fresh perspective to a legendary address.

facts.text: The resort is at 2335 Kalakaua Avenue, Honolulu.
facts.excerpt: Find us at: 2335 Kalakaua Avenue, Honolulu, Hawaii 96815

facts.text: Guests can surf where Duke Kahanamoku shared his love of the ocean with the world.
facts.excerpt: Surf where Duke Kahanamoku shared his love of the ocean with the world

facts.text: Rooms have private balconies connecting guests to the ocean, skyline and energy of Waikiki.
facts.excerpt: private balconies connect you to the ocean, skyline and energy of Waikiki outside

facts.text: Rooms have been newly renovated with redesigned interiors.
facts.excerpt: Wake up in a newly renovated room just steps from the sand.

facts.text: Oceanfront rooms have an unobstructed ocean view over Waikiki Beach right below the private balcony.
facts.excerpt: Wake up to an unobstructed view of the ocean and the gentle sounds of waves crashing on iconic Waikiki Beach right below your private balcony.

facts.text: Club Room and Suite guests get all-day access to the Voyager 47 Club Lounge overlooking Waikiki Beach.
facts.excerpt: Upgrade to a Club Room or Suite for elevated comfort and all-day access to the exclusive Voyager 47 Club Lounge overlooking Waikiki Beach.

facts.text: The Voyager 47 Club Lounge is newly expanded and perched directly above the sand.
facts.excerpt: Newly expanded and perched directly above the sand, the Voyager 47 Club Lounge is your front-row seat to everything that makes this beach legendary.

facts.text: The resort describes Voyager 47 as Waikiki's only all-day private beachfront lounge.
facts.excerpt: Waikiki's only all-day private beachfront lounge

facts.text: Duke's Waikiki is a beachfront restaurant on the sands of Waikiki Beach with island cuisine, cocktails and live music.
facts.excerpt: Guests enjoy fresh island cuisine, handcrafted cocktails and live music right on the sands of Waikiki Beach.

facts.text: Blue Note Hawaii is a jazz and dinner club with two nightly performances.
facts.excerpt: this vibrant jazz and dinner club offers two nightly performances featuring world-class talent

facts.text: Faith Surf School is directly in front of the hotel on Waikiki Beach, teaching surfing, stand-up paddleboarding and outrigger canoe wave riding.
facts.excerpt: The famed Faith Surf School is located directly in front of the hotel, on Waikiki Beach. Learn how to surf, stand-up paddleboard and ride a wave in an outrigger canoe

facts.text: On Sundays, local music legend Henry Kapono plays from 4 to 6 pm at the beachfront Barefoot Bar.
facts.excerpt: On Sundays, enjoy the sounds of local music legend Henry Kapono from 4 - 6 pm right on the beachfront at the Barefoot Bar.

facts.text: The Surfers in Residence program has legendary surfers stay at the resort and share their stories and craft with guests.
facts.excerpt: Join us as legendary surfers stay with us and share their stories and craft with guests.

facts.text: Cultural activities at the resort range from hula lessons to lei making.
facts.excerpt: Take part in everything from hula lessons to lei making for a glimpse into the Hawaiian Islands’ rich history right in the resort.

facts.text: Ukulele lessons are offered at the resort.
facts.excerpt: - Ukulele lessons

facts.text: The beach can be seen from the pool area.
facts.excerpt: if you go to the pool area, you will see the beach from there

facts.text: The Aqualani Beach and Ocean Recreation desk on the beachfront books surfing, paddle boarding and more.
facts.excerpt: they can stop by the Aqualani Beach and Ocean Recreation desk to book surfing, paddle boarding and more

facts.text: The resort is pet-friendly for a fee.
facts.excerpt: - Pet-friendly (fee)

facts.text: A Hawaiian vow renewal ceremony is offered.
facts.excerpt: - Hawaiian vow renewal ceremony

facts.text: The drive to the airport can take from 30 minutes to an hour depending on the time of day.
facts.excerpt: The drive to the airport can take anywhere from 30 minutes to 1-hour as it depends on the time of day.

facts.text: All guest areas are non-smoking.
facts.excerpt: - All guest areas are non-smoking

facts.text: Hula Grill Waikiki is a casual restaurant serving line-caught fish and Oahu-grown produce.
facts.excerpt: Dine in a relaxed, casual setting that serves the freshest line-caught fish, Oahu grown produce, all-natural meats

facts.text: Blue Note Hawaii is heralded as Hawaii's best live music venue.
